title: National platform governance at scale
situation: A multi-platform public-sector ecosystem needed consistent architecture, ownership and delivery controls.
action: Aligned platform governance, integration boundaries, stakeholder ownership and evidence-based reporting across the ecosystem.
result: Scaled governance across 10 integrated platforms supporting 12,000+ entities and 320,000+ automated validations.

title: Turning fragmented data into executive reporting
situation: Cross-institution reporting depended on fragmented operational data and slow preparation cycles.
action: Designed a governed PostgreSQL-centered data environment with pipelines, master data, validation and analytics.
result: Supported 12M+ records/day across 100+ institutions and reduced reporting preparation time by about 70%.

title: Embedded government delivery in Oman
situation: National education services required reliable ministry-side delivery and close stakeholder coordination.
action: Worked inside the Ministry environment across requirements, solution design, development, testing, deployment, training and support.
result: Built direct GCC government-delivery credibility through 2.5+ years embedded at the Ministry of Education and 4+ years in Muscat.

title: Governed enterprise integration
situation: Operational and procurement platforms needed controlled connectivity with Dynamics 365 ERP and CRM.
action: Aligned mappings, REST contracts, workflow ownership, reconciliation, monitoring and vendor responsibilities.
result: Established clearer integration ownership and controlled enterprise connectivity.

title: Adoption as part of architecture
situation: Transformation value depended on production readiness, user adoption and operational continuity—not software delivery alone.
action: Embedded training, service governance, knowledge transfer and continuity into delivery.
